desc: Design the digit DP state with capped prime-exponent vector and zero-product handling.
Implement count_up_to(n) using digit DP over digits of n with tight, started, digit_sum, capped exponents, and zero_product flag.
Define transitions for choosing each next digit, updating sum and exponents correctly, treating leading zeros as not started and real zero digits as making product zero.
At DP end, count a number as beautiful if started and either zero_product is true or the digit sum divides the digit product, using the capped exponents to test divisibility.
Implement beautifulNumbers(l, r) as count_up_to(r) - count_up_to(l - 1).
Run minimal sample/edge validation and report SAMPLE TESTS verdict only.
